Return zero value (0x00000000) from onERC721Received, causing a different successful-return value.
Return the bitwise-negated selector (~onERC721Received.selector) so the return value differs while call still completes.
Replace the assignment to baseToken so initialize sets baseToken to address(0) regardless of the _baseToken argument.
Replace the assignment to baseToken so initialize sets baseToken to the factory address instead of the provided _baseToken.
Replace the assignment to baseToken so initialize sets baseToken to the nft address (mix-up), changing observed baseToken.
Insert an extra assignment before setting baseToken that flips the input: if _baseToken is nonzero set baseToken to address(0), otherwise set to _baseToken, changing resulting baseToken.

Replace assignment to changeFee with assigning changeFee + 1 (increment by 1) so initialized changeFee is different.

Replace assignment to changeFee with assigning the input multiplied by 2 so stored changeFee doubles the provided value.
Remove the feeRate upper-bound check so initialize can set feeRate > 5000.
Clamp feeRate to 5000 if input is larger, so initialize sets feeRate = min(_feeRate, 5000).

Remove setting initialized = true so initialized remains false after initialize completes.
